header.title: From business profile to your NELIAS environment.
header.lead: A guided journey that makes choosing and setting up business software simpler.

steps.title: Tell us about your business
steps.text: Select your industry, activities, size, users, legal entities and operational requirements.

steps.title: Let the Sector Engine work
steps.text: Business rules evaluate your profile and recommend relevant capabilities and sector configuration.

steps.title: Review your recommendation
steps.text: See the suggested plan, included capabilities, optional add-ons and integrations.

steps.title: Understand the price
steps.text: Review a transparent estimate based on plan, capacity and selected options.

steps.title: Subscribe and activate
steps.text: For eligible self-service subscriptions, complete your payment and follow the activation steps to access your dedicated environment.

steps.title: Start and grow
steps.text: Access your dedicated NELIAS environment, complete guided onboarding and evolve over time.

example.label: Example:
example.text: ABC Distribution configures its business profile, reviews a tailored recommendation, selects an eligible subscription and, after activation, accesses abcdistribution.nelias.app.
